This video shares how to fix copper pinhole leaks. For more home renovation tips you can find me at homerepairtutor.com

#plumbing #waterleaks #plumbingtips   

Copper Pinhole Leak Tips

0:07 SharkBite fittings for copper pinhole leaks
0:18 How to cut copper pipes in tight spaces
0:37 How to install SharkBite Max slip coupling
1:02 How to deburr copper pipes
1:40 How to mark depth for SharkBite push-to-connect fittings
1:54 How to install SharkBite Max slip coupling on copper pipes

These supplies were used 

-SharkBite Max slip coupling
-SharkBite depth and deburr tool
-Ridgid deburring tool
-Milwaukee tubing cutter
